text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...I-I can hear it...! My entire body is 
boiling over with the surging pulse of 
power...!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Could it be me!? Have I awakened and 
gained new powers!? Just like what happens 
sometimes in PreFigh!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oooh~! My excitement is overflowing! I 
feel like I could smash a giant meteor to 
pieces~!
